script_text: Stop! Taurus, today’s relationship choices carry unexpectedly serious financial consequences. Venus, the ruler of your Earth sign, moves through your 7th House of partnerships and forms a sextile to the South Node in your 6th House of work. Mars in your 4th House joins that same sextile, linking home strategy to income. Singles, favor someone composed, career-minded, and consistent; let a shared practical interest grow before chasing sparks. If partnered, ask what your partner needs before assuming affection guarantees agreement. The Sun in your 6th House sextiles Pluto in your 11th, revealing leverage in your next negotiation. Price your expertise, secure written terms, and get paid for the difficult problem everyone avoids. Avoid lending money to someone whose promises outpace their schedule, especially if attraction is clouding your judgment. Follow for tomorrow’s reading as the Moon enters your 6th House, sharpening the money conversation.
